note: Reactive performance on agent traces is dominated by whether the hot tier holds the working set (~2.5k blocks touched per request), not by the workload being 'unreactive'. At 2% it is poor; at 5% LRU is near-optimal.
secondary_finding: LRU >> H2O/LFU on agent traces (0.884 vs 0.228), the reverse of Mooncake where frequency wins. Agent loops re-send a contiguous recent prefix, so recency is the right signal there.
